body: An apartment in central Tuzla, close to the Pannonian Lakes, from €49 a night. Book direct over WhatsApp or the enquiry form with no agency commission — or go through Airbnb and Booking.com if you prefer a platform.
The page shows the rooms, amenities, photo gallery and the location on a map, so guests see what they are getting before they ask.
